checks.label: not up two days in a row

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 5 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=17 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.34 tightness=0.81 base_volume_vs_leg=0.82 base_volume_vs_avg=0.77

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 2.0% vs its 20-SMA, -5.5% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The chart shows ANF has already made four prior breakouts in this move over 55 sessions with an 80.6% gain, making today's burst the fifth push out of a rising structure — the trend is visibly mature and repeated pushes are clearly visible in the Aug–Sep region. The burst bar itself is not the widest of the last five sessions (RE FAIL, vs_prior_5=0.97) and volume ranks only 15th of the last 60, so the expansion lacks conviction. The base shaded box sits well below the prior Aug highs around 150–155, meaning there is meaningful overhead supply from that prior trading zone directly above the signal close.
claude.key_risk: This is the fifth breakout attempt in a mature 55-session, 80% move with prior breakouts working only 1 of 4 times, making follow-through statistically poor.
claude.entry_note: Skip if ANF opens below the signal day's close of 141.40 or gaps up more than 1% above it without holding early strength in the first 30 minutes.
